title: Van and Nincs — There Is / There Isn't

sections.content: van says something exists or is located somewhere; nincs is its negative. Never use van to say what something IS — that's zero copula (Ez egy könyv, not Ez van egy könyv).
sections.title: Existence, not identity

items.english: The book is in the kitchen.

sections.content: van never means 'to be' when naming what something is — Ez egy könyv, not Ez van egy könyv. van means 'there is' or 'is located,' as in A könyv a konyhában van (The book is in the kitchen).
nincs is a fusion of nem (not) + van — that's why it replaces van outright instead of pairing with nem like other verbs do.
